absent_coverage: Constant-VDD settled current only: supply-ramp behavior (inrush, release timing) is sim/supply-ramp-top, not measured here.
No ll/hh passive-skew axis and no mismatch Monte Carlo: this is the {tt,ss,ff,sf,fs} x temperature x supply corner grid only.
PTAT/CTAT are left open (no output buffer exists), so no sensor-output load current is included in temp-iq.
MASSIST's current is inside the por_output_chain attribution; it is not separated from the rest of that sub-cell here.
No numeric ceiling is proposed; a follow-on decision record would use these records as evidence (DR-003 TBD-4/5/6).
The fleet PDK commit is not reported by the runner; agreement with the local cross-check is the only evidence the fleet model library matches the pin.

crosscheck.text: por-iq: local ngspice-42 status **ok**, I = 79.443 uA, contention 73.825 uA; fleet ngspice-46 status ok, I = 79.443 uA; |fleet - local|/local = 0.000% (tolerance for 'matches': 2%, stated here because the engines differ: ngspice-42 local vs the fleet runner's). iq-total: local probe returned no waveform (error); UNRESOLVED -- the single local ngspice-42 run was stopped by the operator after ~33 min / ~64 CPU-min without finishing (shared host), so this state has NO local cross-check and the fleet value for tt/27C/3.30V is not cross-checked.

definitions.attribution: four 0 V ammeters in series with each sub-cell's VDD pin, inserted by the driver in the generated deck (electrically ideal; same deck both states).
definitions.measurement: transient from a physical 0 V start, VDD = min(final, 1e4 V/s * t), held to 30 ms; I = -i(BVDD) time-averaged over the trailing 25-30 ms window.
definitions.non-physical-branch: any saved node outside [-0.3 V, VDD+0.5 V] in the trailing window, settled total current <= 0, or a settled sub-cell current < -1 nA (the issue #19/#22/#86 signature documented in design/temp_core.md ~l.145-172). Applied identically in both states.
definitions.nonconverged: klt/ngspice produced no waveform for the point, or the run ended before the trailing window.
definitions.por-iq hold: - RESETn is a DUT output (releases by itself above VPOR-rise), so the por-iq testbench (`testbench/tb_temp_por_iq_por.sch`) forces it low with a 0 V voltage source VRST from RESETn to VSS for the whole run. The DUT netlist is untouched. VRST's current is not part of the VDD measurement; the output stage's contention against it IS inside -i(BVDD) and is read as i(VRST).
definitions.settling: ok only if trailing-window mean is within 1% of the 20-25 ms window mean, trailing pk-pk <= 2% of the mean, VDD within 5 mV of target, and the asked-for state holds (iq-total: RESETn > 0.8*VDD; por-iq: RESETn <= 50 mV). Otherwise `unsettled`.
definitions.state definitions: por-iq = RESETn asserted (low), directly simulated; iq-total = natural released state, directly simulated in its own run (never a sum); temp-iq = iq-total - por-iq, labelled incremental.

experiment.claim: Issue #107 -- EVIDENCE ONLY, NOT a spec claim and NOT a proposed ceiling (DR-003 row 7 TBD-4/5/6 are owned by a follow-on decision record that would use this result). Records the settled VDD supply current of the unchanged assembled design/netlist/temp_por_top.spice (as drawn: bias_core + temp_core + por_comparator + por_output_chain with the real shared IBIAS node and the real RESETn -> temp_core.EN feedback) in two directly simulated states -- por-iq (RESETn asserted/low, which disables temp_core) and iq-total (natural released state) -- and the derived incremental temp-iq = iq-total - por-iq, over {tt, ss, ff, sf, fs} x {-40, 27, 125 C} x {2.97, 3.30, 3.63 V}. iq-total is measured in its own simulation and is NOT a sum; the per-sub-cell currents are attribution only, taken from the same runs, and the direct-vs-attribution-sum discrepancy is reported (spec/porting-plan.md Sec1.1). Every grid point carries an explicit status (ok / non-physical-branch / unsettled / nonconverged).
